name: kanna
description: Kanna — a tiny desktop AI companion.
author: Kanna

scripts.dist:all: npm run clean:dist && npm run piper:build && npm run dist && npm run piper:build:cuda && npm run dist:cuda
scripts.piper:build: py -3 -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --onefile --name kanna-piper-server --distpath resources/piper --workpath .opencode/piper-build --specpath .opencode/piper-build --hidden-import piper --hidden-import onnxruntime --collect-all piper resources/piper/piper_server.py
scripts.stt:build: py -3 -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --onefile --name kanna-stt-server --distpath resources/stt --workpath .opencode/stt-build --specpath .opencode/stt-build --collect-all vosk resources/stt/stt_server.py
